capabilities: Show cited and citing papers for references in a sidebar
Detect reference IDs (DOI, arXiv, PMID, citekey, URL) in the current note
Search references online to insert details or create a new note
Copy paper metadata in user-defined formats such as BibTeX or wikilinks
Display a literature graph of citation connections between published papers
disambiguation: Not a map of vault note links; it maps scholarly citations retrieved from Semantic Scholar or a local reference library.
extras: The README points to a separate Wiki page for a detailed usage guide; styling is customizable via the Obsidian-style-settings plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to detect reference IDs in notes, look up academic papers online, or explore cited/citing citation networks.

relations.evidence: Open reference in the Zotero Library
Open the paper in Semantic Scholar
Bibtex CSL JSON(Better BibTex Zotero Plugin feature, auto updates with changes in the library)

summary: Citation manager that lists cited and citing papers in a sidebar, searches references online, and draws a literature graph of citation connections.
